edges.cite: Garlan & Shaw, 'An Introduction to Software Architecture' (1993), Dataflow systems

edges.cite: Brooks 1986, 'A Robust Layered Control System for a Mobile Robot'
edges.note: Behavior modules are stacked in layers where higher layers subsume the outputs of lower ones.

edges.cite: Buschmann et al., POSA1 (1996), Broker (Related Patterns)

edges.cite: Buschmann et al., POSA1 (1996), Microkernel (Related Patterns)

edges.cite: Fielding 2000 dissertation, ch.5 (REST constraint derivation)

edges.cite: Fielding 2000 dissertation, ch.5 (Layered System constraint)
edges.note: REST's layered-system constraint permits intermediaries (proxies, gateways) between client and origin.

edges.cite: Fielding 2000 dissertation, ch.5 (Code-on-Demand, optional constraint)
edges.note: REST optionally extends clients by downloading executable code (the code-on-demand constraint).

edges.cite: Fuggetta, Picco & Vigna 1998, 'Understanding Code Mobility', IEEE TSE

edges.cite: Fuggetta, Picco & Vigna 1998, 'Understanding Code Mobility', IEEE TSE
edges.note: COD moves only know-how to a resourced client; a mobile agent migrates code+state+data itself.

edges.cite: Fuggetta, Picco & Vigna 1998, 'Understanding Code Mobility', IEEE TSE
edges.note: REV ships code to a remote resource and returns results; a mobile agent carries execution state along.

edges.cite: Hohpe & Woolf, 'Enterprise Integration Patterns' (2003), Integration Styles

edges.cite: Hohpe & Woolf, 'Enterprise Integration Patterns' (2003), Integration Styles

edges.cite: Hohpe & Woolf, 'Enterprise Integration Patterns' (2003), Integration Styles

edges.cite: Hohpe & Woolf, 'Enterprise Integration Patterns' (2003), Integration Styles
edges.note: Integration-style choice: shared data store vs asynchronous messaging.

edges.cite: Hohpe & Woolf, 'Enterprise Integration Patterns' (2003), Integration Styles
edges.note: Synchronous RPC couples in time; messaging decouples sender and receiver in time and availability.

edges.cite: Hohpe & Woolf, 'Enterprise Integration Patterns' (2003), Message Bus

edges.cite: Hohpe & Woolf, 'Enterprise Integration Patterns' (2003), Message Bus / Canonical Data Model
edges.note: A message bus requires a common (canonical) data model so all plugged-in apps interoperate.

edges.cite: Richards & Ford, 'Fundamentals of Software Architecture' (2020), SOA

edges.cite: Garlan & Shaw, 'An Introduction to Software Architecture' (1993), Independent components
edges.note: Two independent-components subtypes: explicit message-passing processes vs implicit event systems.

edges.note: C2 components communicate only via asynchronous notifications/requests, i.e. implicit invocation.

edges.cite: Armstrong, 'Programming Erlang'/OTP design principles
edges.note: OTP structures actor systems as supervision trees for fault isolation and restart.

edges.cite: Garlan & Shaw, 'An Introduction to Software Architecture' (1993), Data-centered (repository/blackboard)

edges.cite: Garlan & Shaw, 'An Introduction to Software Architecture' (1993), Virtual machines/interpreters

edges.cite: Garlan & Shaw, 'An Introduction to Software Architecture' (1993), Virtual machines

edges.cite: Yoder & Johnson 2002, 'The Adaptive Object-Model Architectural Style'

edges.cite: Yoder & Johnson 2002, 'The Adaptive Object-Model Architectural Style'

edges.cite: Kreps 2014, 'Questioning the Lambda Architecture' (O'Reilly)

edges.cite: Kreps 2014, 'Questioning the Lambda Architecture'

edges.cite: Kreps 2014, 'Questioning the Lambda Architecture'

edges.cite: Fowler, 'CQRS'/'Event Sourcing' (martinfowler.com); Young on CQRS+ES

edges.cite: White, 'Making Embedded Systems' (2011), ch.5 Architecture

edges.cite: Richards & Ford, 'Fundamentals of Software Architecture' (2020), Service-Based Architecture
